# Impulsive

Impulsive is a privacy-first behaviour-change support app for adults who want to interrupt difficult digital habit moments, create space before acting, redirect through a short structured intervention and build more deliberate patterns over time.

Impulsive has launched through Google Play for Android. Availability can depend on the Google Play release or testing access that applies to a particular account or region. Do not infer production-track status, downloads, purchases, revenue, retention, ratings or customer numbers beyond primary evidence.

The current product includes My Moment Plans, evidence-qualified Familiar Steps, short structured interventions, optional app and website protection, private behavioural history and optional encrypted recovery for eligible accounts. Recommendation and actual user choice remain separate, as do lifecycle evidence, immediate feedback and later observation.

The Personal Adaptation Engine is planned future R&D unless later implementation evidence proves otherwise. It must not be described as a current live capability.

Impulsive is not a medical device, therapy service, diagnosis tool, crisis-support service or clinically validated treatment.

Markdown mirrors for AI discovery:
